diff_summary: The comparison inside the binary-search loop was changed from `a[mid] < x` to `a[mid] <= x`.
why_its_a_bug: With `<=`, an element equal to x pushes `lo` past it, so the function returns the insertion point to the RIGHT of any existing equal elements. That is bisect_right's contract, not bisect_left's. The docstring still promises the leftmost position.
hint_level_description: The loop terminates and the result is always a valid index -- look closely at what happens on the exact boundary where a[mid] equals x.
